## Page 1
UrbanScenes-10K: A Large-Scale Dataset for Street-Level Semantic Understanding
Alice Example, Bob Sample
Institute of Vision, Example University
Abstract
We introduce UrbanScenes-10K, a new large-scale dataset of ten thousand annotated street images collected across twelve cities. We
release the annotation protocol and a benchmark with a public leaderboard. We evaluate several existing models on the benchmark
and report results. The dataset, annotation guidelines and evaluation protocol are publicly available.
1 Introduction
Street-level understanding lacks diverse data. Our annotation challenge covers lighting changes and weather. Table 1 compares the
dataset with prior benchmark collections. Models from the literature are trained with their default settings and the layer
configurations are taken from the original papers.
